method: configuration rebuilt from the wording and classified by the definitions: two lines crossing / a straight line (rays and their opposite rays: vertically opposite = each arm opposite an arm of the other angle; linear pair = one common arm, other arms opposite); parallel lines with a transversal (parallel lines horizontal; for each angle: direction of its transversal arm and side of its parallel arm; same direction + same side = corresponding, opposite direction + opposite side + both inside = alternate, opposite direction + same side + both inside = co-interior); triangle angle sum; exterior angle (side extended, the two opposite interior angles). The stated numeric step is checked (equal / sums to 180 / sum of two)
